name: Hotel Dorfplatzl
beschreibung:
History

The Aparthotel Dorfplatzl describes itself on dorfplatzl.at as a 4-star house in Tux and writes of hospitality in the third generation. The footer names Oswald Gredler GmbH, Vorderlanersbach 71, 6293 Tux, telephone +43 5287 87220, email info@dorfplatzl.at. A founding year before the third generation is not published on the homepage retrieved. Guest texts on the same page address Nina and Ossi by name. Those are published forms of address used by guests, not a second imprint line, and are not fixed as the sole owner names. The rooms and apartments measure 20 to 80 square metres for 1 to 8 people. A part was, according to the page, renovated recently, with new bathrooms, living areas and kitchens. The wellness area is described as newly renovated.

Getting there

The address is Vorderlanersbach 71, 6293 Tux. The page names the location in the village centre of Tux-Vorderlanersbach and writes that the valley station lies immediately at the house. A guest text on the page mentions a bus stop directly at the house and parking spaces with three charging points for electric cars. That is a published guest text, not house rules of its own. A line number is not given by the homepage. In the house there are ski-pass sales.

Tips

The facilities of the house include a wellness area with a Finnish sauna, a Biosauana and a rest room with a fireplace, a fitness room with Technogym equipment, a children’s playroom, childcare free of charge, a mini supermarket and the Pizzeria Platzl, which is open from 17:00. Breakfast is described in the guest texts as a buffet. The house itself counts as winter activities skiing, cross-country skiing, tobogganing, winter hiking and snowshoe hiking, in summer hiking, mountain biking, e-mountain biking, golf, climbing and paragliding. Those are possibilities of the surroundings as the house lists them, not all of them offers with an in-house guide. The pizzeria is the in-house à-la-carte restaurant. Prices and check-in times are not on the homepage retrieved.
kurzbeschreibung: 4-star aparthotel Dorfplatzl of Oswald Gredler GmbH at Vorderlanersbach 71, Tux, in the third generation, with a pizzeria, wellness, a supermarket and ski-pass sales.
